source: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF), General Directorate of Agriculture, Department of Agricultural Extension — 'បច្ចេកទេសដាំដំណាំឪឡឹក' (Watermelon Cultivation Techniques), 2017.
text:
As an alternative to plastic mulch, farmers may cover the planting bed with a layer of rice straw, spread to a thickness of roughly 6 to 10 centimeters over the bed surface.

Benefits of straw mulching: it helps the soil retain moisture for longer; it reduces soil erosion/washing away of soil; it keeps the soil looser (less compacted), which allows the watermelon's roots to grow and spread faster; it reduces loss of applied fertilizer; and it suppresses weed growth on the bed.
